local_name.title: Local Name
local_name.description: Directory name the catalog is installed under.

role.title: Role
role.description: Where the catalog came from: 'subscribed' for one cloned from a publisher, 'owned' for one created on this grid. Provenance only - see write_access for what may be changed.

write_access.title: Write Access
write_access.description: Whether this grid has confirmed it can push to the catalog's repository, and so may add, remove and publish content.

can_author.title: Can Author
can_author.description: Whether editing is worth offering: write access is either already confirmed, or the catalog is somewhere a push could confirm it against - an SSH repository, or a folder on this server.

url.title: Url
url.description: Repository the catalog is pulled from, or published to.

transport.title: Transport
transport.description: 'https' for a public catalog, 'ssh' for a private one, 'local' for one in a folder on this server.

ssh_key_path.title: Ssh Key Path
ssh_key_path.description: Key pinned on this catalog; empty means it follows the admin user's key.

ca_bundle_path.title: Ca Bundle Path
ca_bundle_path.description: CA bundle this catalog's https certificate is verified against; empty means the host's default trust store.

last_pulled.title: Last Pulled
last_pulled.description: When the catalog was last updated.

created_at.title: Created At
created_at.description: When an owned catalog was created.

last_published.title: Last Published
last_published.description: When an owned catalog was last published.

export_path.title: Export Path
export_path.description: Folder this catalog was last exported to, offered as the default the next time.

last_exported.title: Last Exported
last_exported.description: When the catalog was last written to a folder.

present.title: Present
present.description: Whether the catalog's directory is still on disk.

node_count.title: Node Count
node_count.description: Number of node templates the catalog provides.

library_count.title: Library Count
library_count.description: Number of library versions the catalog provides.

catalogs.title: Catalogs
catalogs.description: Every catalog installed on this grid.
